My agents are busily doing a big refactor to part of TanStack DB when I squinted at a writeup and it looked a lot like TCP. I suggested as such and the agent said yes we actually are more or less designing this like TCP (a similar problem space queries in those ideas) and then it said "and since you bring that up, here's another cleanup that analogy suggests (collapses state) and here's a list of other well know TCP failures we can start testing against.

I just really really love coding with agents 😂
